facts: Protocol conversion is not a universal corporate dollar-redemption agreement or direct title to every backing vehicle.
The configured OpenUSD route is Bridge/Stripe's exact token, not Origin OUSD. Configuration does not establish a funded balance.
Official JAAA Ethereum/Avalanche identities are corroborated; share-class rights, creditor priority and bridge consolidation remain unverified.
The published Galaxy warehouse description does not bind the exact receipt to an executed security agreement or corporate guarantee.
No signed protocol-wide reserve or solvency assurance is established; code audits and scoped vehicle assurance answer different questions.
